title: Elements of Gaelic Grammar

authorInfo.bio: Alexander Stewart (1764–1821) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Elements of Gaelic Grammar" by Alexander Stewart is a comprehensive grammatical treatise on the Scottish Gaelic language written in the late 19th century. The work is structured into four main parts, focusing on pronunciation and orthography, parts of speech, syntax, and derivation and composition.
